subject: Re: LumenStack x Redwood co-host roadshow + MDF request
messages:
From: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenstack.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marketing@lumenstack.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: LumenStack + Redwood: co-host regional roadshow proposal

Hi Connor,

Hope you9re well. LumenStack is putting together a small regional roadshow (San Francisco -> Denver -> Austin) focused on inference at the edge and hybrid ops. We9re pitching a 90-minute mini-session + demo booth in each city for customers and partners.

We9d love to co-host with Redwood: short joint talk (25 mins), joint demo booth (10x10 shell), and a customer roundtable. We have MDF allocated for partner co-hosts and can propose a $25k contribution per city if Redwood can support demo infrastructure and two engineers on site.

Attached is a one-pager with audience profile and estimated attendee counts. Can you let me know:
- Who at Redwood would own the program?
- Any SSO/guest access constraints for running a Redwood-hosted demo at a partner booth?
- Timeline for approving MDF request and next steps (we9re targeting the SF date June 9).

Thanks,
Sasha Patel
Head of Partnerships, LumenStack

Attachment: lumenstack-roadshow-onepager.pdf

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenstack.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LumenStack + Redwood: co-host regional roadshow proposal

Hi Sasha  

Thanks for the note and the one-pager  

Connor here (field marketing). Redwood is very interested — the ask aligns with our Q2 demand-gen plans. Quick answers up front:
- Program owner: I9ll lead program ops; Marissa will handle partner marketing and co-branded assets.
- Demo infra: We can run a demo from a dedicated Redwood Dedicated instance or a Private (VPC) staging environment. For partner booths we normally avoid exposing production keys; we prefer short-lived tokens and a local cached model to avoid network flakiness.
- MDF timeline: we need a completed MDF request form + expected deliverables and co-marketing commitments. Typical turnaround is 7-10 business days once we have the form and the event budget line items.

Can you send the MDF terms and a copy of the proposed attendee list? Also looping in Ben (events ops) to confirm booth logistics.

Next step: If you9re OK we9ll draft a mutual action plan with milestones (marketing assets, speaker deck, logistic deadlines) and share by next Wednesday.

Cheers,
Connor O	Brien
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
Office: +1 415-555-0182

From: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenstack.com>
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com
Cc: marketing@lumenstack.com
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: LumenStack + Redwood: co-host regional roadshow proposal

Thanks Connor — great to hear. Attached is the LumenStack MDF terms doc and a rough attendee breakdown. We9re flexible on the demo setup; priority is a reliable experience so your recommendation for a cached model + short-lived token sounds perfect.

MDF terms (high level):
- $25k per city, split 60/40 (LumenStack/Redwood) for venue, promotion, and hospitality
- Co-branded social ads and email send commitments (two email blasts + three social posts per city)
- Lead-sharing within 48 hours post-event (HubSpot sync)
- Basic brand guidelines included

We9ve added a DocuSign link for the MOU but we can wait until the mutual action plan is in place.

Best,
Sasha

Attachment: lumenstack-mdf-terms.docx
Link: https://app.docusign.com/documents/LS-RW-2026-044

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: connor_obrien@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 9 Mar 2026 14:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LumenStack + Redwood: co-host regional roadshow proposal

Looping internal ops notes here so we have a single place to track logistics:

- Booth footprint: 10x10 shell per city. Recommend shared backwall with dual logos and separate demo table for Redwood unit. Will need power (2x 15A), one monitor (48	in), and a network drop.
- Shipping: prefer using Redwood freight account; LumenStack to cover inbound/outbound customs if any.
- Inventory: 2 demo laptops, 1 local GPU box (NVIDIA T4), branded swag (totes + stickers), pop-up banner.
- Headcount: 2 engineers (onsite in SF), 1 AE + 1 Marketing rep. Travel estimate per city: $3.5k per person.
- Lead capture: use LumenStack tablets + HubSpot form. Need HubSpot API key scoped for lead ingestion only. Security wants lead payloads to omit PII beyond email/name/title.

Action items:
1) Connor: finalize MOU + MDF request form and attach budget line items.
2) Marissa: draft co-branded email copy and social assets calendar.
3) Ben: confirm freight and produce shared-booth-layout-v1.pdf.

I9ll flag any permits (city-specific) once dates are finalized.

-Ben
Senior Events Manager, Redwood Inference

From: connor_obrien@redwood.com
To: Sasha Patel <sasha@lumenstack.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 12 Mar 2026 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: LumenStack + Redwood: co-host regional roadshow proposal

Hi Sasha,

Great progress — appreciated. Attached are the Redwood MDF request form and our proposed shared booth layout. Highlights of the mutual action plan we9re proposing:

- MDF: Redwood requests a $15k committed co-investment per city (we9ll invoice LumenStack for the 60%/40% split per your terms). Payment terms NET30 after the event and evidence of spend.
- Marketing: Joint email cadence (LumenStack sends first blast, Redwood provides copy/assets within 5 business days of MOU).
- Logistics: Redwood will provide one local GPU box with cached model snapshot; LumenStack to provide the customer-facing demo narrative and lead tablets.
- Security: demos will use short-lived tokens and a staging API key; no production data will be used.
- Rollout: SF (June 9), Denver (June 16), Austin (June 23). Please confirm speakers per city by March 19.

Attachments: redwood-mdf-request-form.xlsx, shared-booth-layout-v1.pdf

If that aligns I9ll submit the MDF request and set up a joint planning calendar.

Cheers,
Connor O	Brien
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
